info.title: FPR API
info.description: Generated from the route contracts in `@fpr/contracts` by `pnpm contracts:openapi`. `x-roles` lists the roles a route accepts. `x-anonymize` marks a field the anonymizer replaces for an anonymous viewer: `personal`, `euro`, or `quantity`.
